description: Rete Geodetica e Monografie is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by regione.abruzzo.it. The Regional Geotopographic Network consists of summits of a network of high precision planoaltimetric trust points, photoidentifiable or made photoidentifiable. The vertices are an equispaced mesh, refined along the river rods, which guarantees at least three vertices per municipality, for a total of 5,000 points. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Geodetic Network and Monographs" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include rete geodetica. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
